youtube.title: Why Americans drive on the right: the wagon story #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Step off a plane and look the wrong way, and the road can kill you. So why didn't we all pick one side? In early America, huge freight wagons were pulled by teams of horses with no driver's seat, so the driver rode the back horse on the left. From there, the easiest way to judge the gap with an oncoming wagon was to keep right. That's the story told about the Conestoga wagons. Full episode on the channel.
